sehemu: Part I: Contribution and Allocation of Revenue of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Joint Finance Commission consisting of not more than seven members who shall be appointed by the President in accordance with this Article and the provisions of a law enacted by Parliament. (2) The functions of the Commission shall be— (a) to analyse the revenue and expenditure arising from, or relating to, the implementation of Union Matters and make recommendations to the two Governments concerning the contribution and allocation of each Government; (b) to keep under constant scrutiny the system of financial operations of the United Republic and also the financial relations between the two Governments; and (c) to perform such other functions as the President shall assign to the Commission or as the President shall direct, and in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament.
